items.title: Micron Has $14.6 Billion in China-Linked Revenue. Are These New U.S. Chip Export Rules a Threat?
items.summary: Washington just drew a new line around where AI chips can go, and Micron's growth runs straight through AI data centers worldwide. Management says China exposure is fading, but the stock already slid sharply. What does the new rule actually threaten?

items.title: Eli Lilly is trouncing Nvidia — and the weight-loss drug trade is beating AI again
items.summary: Since its Oct. 6 record, Nvidia has shed more than $1.7 trillion in market value. Eli Lilly has added more than $250 billion over the same stretch, a gain topped only by Apple among the market's biggest stocks.

items.title: Micron’s AI Memory Is Nearly Sold Out Through 2027 — That Could Be Its Biggest Risk
items.summary: Micron is printing profits that once seemed impossible, and its customers have noticed. One of the chip industry's most powerful buyers may be quietly nurturing the rival that could erase those gains.

items.title: Not Nvidia. Not Micron. These 2 Under-the-Radar AI Stocks Could Be Worth Holding Through 2030
items.summary: Investors should consider taking a closer look at these underrated AI infrastructure stocks given their terrific growth potential.

items.title: U.S. chip stocks slide as traders unwind Nvidia rival bets before earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. chip stocks are down sharply on Monday as traders took profits on recent gains in Nvidia’s rivals ahead of the AI giant’s earnings, while worries about tighter export controls added to the pressure.

items.title: AI Chip Stocks Extend Their Sell-Off as Monday Opens Deep in the Red
items.summary: Chip stocks face a ~$260B hit at Monday's open after losing $650B in two days, as Nvidia's CEO crisis, rising yields and export fears.

items.title: Micron Sinks 5% as Tighter US Chip Export Rules Deepen Memory Selloff
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron fell 5% today, along with SK hynix and AMD, after a new US rule required licenses for advanced chip exports to five countries. The selloff prices Micron’s earnings as a peak, but analysts expect them to more than double in fiscal 2027.

items.title: Micron Stock Has Soared 150% YTD -- Analysts Expect Shares Could Nearly Double by 2027
